en: Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic views and heavy handwritten text in Bulgarian. The upper images show a park scene with a fountain and a church spire in the background, and a long brick institutional building. The lower image depicts a large two‑story neoclassical building with columns, likely a public or charitable institution, with people gathered in front. The front side is filled with cursive writing surrounding the images and a round red postal cancellation mark.
